reconcile.note: Gill limits Genesis 9's covenant to a universal, worldwide deluge, allowing the local flood imagery in Nahum 1:8 to describe a limited judgment on one city.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible reads Nahum 1:8's overrunning flood as God again destroying by water, against the Genesis 9 covenant never to flood the earth.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: neither will there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
sides.verseText: I will establish my covenant with you; neither will all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of the flood; neither will there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.\"

sides.snippet: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
